publicReleaseNotes: Hosted setup can turn off email and sign in the owner with rer signin. This release uses rer 0.2.144 and updates Business policy and relay custody.
agentUpdateInstructions: Install the frozen dependencies and apply 0081_agent_door_authority.sql with the normal update. Carry forward the current mail provider, sender and credentials. To deploy without email, configure MAIL_PROVIDER=none and use rer signin with the deployment's Cloudflare credentials.
